name: 36542 · Gulf Shores, AL
findings: ZIP 36542 (Gulf Shores) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36542 (Gulf Shores) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
